story.iWant: Holo universal format types in /holo namespace
story.soThat: I can translate between provider formats and Holo's canonical format
story.tasks:
### Define HoloRequest Interface - Create HoloRequest interface in src/holo/types.ts - Add messages field (HoloMessage[]) - Add model field (string) - Add temperature field (number, optional) - Add maxTokens field (number, optional) - Add stream field (boolean, optional) - Add tools field (Tool[], optional) - Add other common request fields (top_p, frequency_penalty, etc.) - Add JSDoc documentation - Explain HoloRequest as universal input format - Note mirrors OpenAI API structure - Show example request
### Define HoloResponse Interface - Create HoloResponse interface in src/holo/types.ts - Add id field (string) - Add model field (string) - Add choices field (HoloChoice[]) - Add usage field (HoloUsage) - Add created field (number - timestamp) - Add object field (string - "chat.completion") - Add JSDoc documentation - Explain HoloResponse as universal output format - Show example response
### Define HoloMessage Interface - Create HoloMessage interface in src/holo/types.ts - Add role field ("system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool") - Add content field (string | null) - Add name field (string, optional) - function/tool name - Add toolCalls field (ToolCall[], optional) - Add toolCallId field (string, optional) - Add JSDoc documentation - Explain message structure - Show examples for each role type
### Define Supporting Types - Create HoloChoice interface - Add index field (number) - Add message field (HoloMessage) - Add finishReason field (string) - Create HoloUsage interface - Add promptTokens field (number) - Add completionTokens field (number) - Add totalTokens field (number) - Create Tool interface - Add type field ("function") - Add function field (FunctionDefinition) - Create ToolCall interface - Add id field (string) - Add type field ("function") - Add function field (FunctionCall)
### Implement Holo Type Validators - Create holoRequestValidator in src/holo/validators.ts - Validate HoloRequest structure - Use satisfies Type<HoloRequest> pattern - Create holoResponseValidator - Validate HoloResponse structure - Use satisfies Type<HoloResponse> pattern - Create holoMessageValidator - Validate HoloMessage structure - Use satisfies Type<HoloMessage> pattern
### Update Barrel Exports - Export from src/holo/index.ts - Export HoloRequest interface - Export HoloResponse interface - Export HoloMessage interface - Export supporting types - Export validators
### Test Types and Validators - Create test cases - Valid Holo types → validation passes - Invalid structures → validation fails - Verify TypeScript compilation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: **Given** Common SDK structure exists **When** I define Holo format types **Then** src/holo/types.ts exports HoloRequest interface **And** HoloRequest includes: messages, model, temperature, maxTokens, stream, tools **And** src/holo/types.ts exports HoloResponse interface **And** HoloResponse includes: id, model, choices, usage, created **And** src/holo/types.ts exports HoloMessage interface **And** HoloMessage includes: role, content, name?, toolCalls?, toolCallId? **And** src/holo/validators.ts exports ArkType validators for Holo types **And** /holo subpath export includes types and validators **And** JSDoc explains Holo format is universal translation hub
